text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace burned with a quiet, 
passionate fire. There's no such thing as 
an insurmountable common sense. To prove 
that to everyone watching—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To defeat the overwhelmingly powerful Mr. 
C.B. Her resolute determination ignited a 
fire in her rivals' hearts as well. The 
final race of the three-bout showdown, the 
Kikuka Sho, begins...!
